design_change_reason: Reduce analyst-chosen architecture multiplicity. Freeze one broad, theory-bounded astrology feature universe and let regularization/hyperparameters be selected only inside subject-disjoint inner CV.

three_model_roles.ASTROLOGY_ONLY: Candidate production signal. Uses astrology primitives only. No age/calendar/axis/wave or Production Control.
three_model_roles.NUISANCE_ONLY: Dataset-bias diagnostic. Uses chronology/age/axis/collection-wave structure only. It is not a production model.
three_model_roles.NUISANCE_PLUS_ASTROLOGY: Incremental-signal diagnostic. Tests whether the exact same astrology feature universe adds out-of-sample information after nuisance structure is already available. It is not a production model.

astrology_feature_universe.name: ALL_ORTHODOX_DYNAMIC_V1
included_families: Daewoon/Sewoon dynamic element, yin-yang and branch encodings
exact dynamic Ten-God x natal-strength interactions

excluded.nuisance_age_calendar_axis_wave: Diagnostic covariates only, never astrology candidate features.
excluded.static_natal_only_features: Within-subject pair differences cancel static natal-only quantities; including them adds columns without pair signal.
excluded.flattened_shinsal_runtime_tree: Not a stable bounded primitive universe: prior V4 implementation recursively flattened keyword-matching engine subtrees, making dimensionality/version lineage harder to control. May be tested later only as a separately frozen sensitivity universe.

feature_screening_before_fit: drop exact zero-variance columns using TRAIN fold only
drop exact duplicate columns using TRAIN fold only

winner_eligible_models.name: ALL_ORTHODOX_RIDGE_AUTO
winner_eligible_models.purpose: Dense shrinkage baseline over the full frozen astrology universe.

winner_eligible_models.name: ALL_ORTHODOX_ELASTICNET_AUTO
winner_eligible_models.purpose: Primary automatic feature-selection model over the same full frozen universe.
winner_eligible_models.feature_selection_rule: A coefficient is selected only by the fitted ElasticNet inside each training fold. No manual feature inclusion/removal after seeing scores.

diagnostic_only_models.name: TG10_RIDGE_DIAGNOSTIC
diagnostic_only_models.purpose: Theory sanity check only; cannot win or define the final architecture.

secondary_metrics: subject-bootstrap conditional delta of nuisance+astrology vs nuisance
validation.BROAD_role: predeclared sensitivity only; cannot create a new architecture

winner_rule: Only the two full-universe automatic models are winner-eligible. Among models passing every frozen gate, choose higher PRIMARY astrology-only subject-macro accuracy; tie-break by larger conditional delta, then Ridge for simplicity.
next_if_winner: Freeze the astrology-only full-PRIMARY model and coefficients, then benchmark once against Production Control without retuning. Only after that may sealed CONFIRM be opened/researched.
next_if_no_winner: Keep CONFIRM sealed. Diagnose representation on DEV only; do not add hand-picked features based on leaderboard results.
